sentence_example: Seine Worte tönen hohl in meinen Ohren.
sentence_example_translation_en: His words sound hollow in my ears.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Его слова звучат пусто в моих ушах.
sentence_synonym: Seine Worte klingen hohl in meinen Ohren.
typical_collocations: hohl tönen; Haare tönen; getöntes Glas
usage_comments_en: 'tönen' has two distinct meanings: 'to sound' (often in an empty, loud, or specific tone) and 'to tint/color' temporarily (such as hair or glass).

sentence_example: Er trägt heute eine Brille mit getönten Gläsern.
sentence_example_translation_en: Today he is wearing glasses with tinted lenses.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Сегодня на нем очки с тонированными стеклами.
sentence_synonym: Er trägt heute eine Brille mit gefärbten Gläsern.
typical_collocations: getönte Scheiben; getönte Tagescreme; getöntes Glas
usage_comments_en: Used as an adjective, typically referring to glass (sunglasses, car windows) or cosmetic products (moisturizer with minor pigmentation).

sentence_example: Das monotone Getön der Maschinen erfüllte die Fabrikhalle.
sentence_example_translation_en: The monotonous drone of the machines filled the factory floor.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Монотонный гул машин наполнял фабричный цех.
sentence_synonym: Das monotone Getöne der Maschinen erfüllte die Fabrikhalle.
typical_collocations: monotones Getön; dumpfes Getön; lautes Getön
usage_comments_en: A collective noun formed with the ge- prefix, denoting a continuous or repeating sound. It is literary and rarely used compared to 'Geräusch' or 'Lärm'.

sentence_example: Ich kann sein arrogantes Getöne nicht mehr hören.
sentence_example_translation_en: I can't listen to his arrogant boasting anymore.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Я больше не могу слышать его высокомерное хвастовство.
sentence_synonym: Ich kann seine arrogante Prahlerei nicht mehr hören.
typical_collocations: großes Getöne; lautes Getöne; arrogantes Getöne
usage_comments_en: Colloquial, often derogatory noun describing loud, boasting talk or empty promises. Derived from the idiom 'große Töne spucken' (to brag).

sentence_example: Sie kaufte eine Tönung für ihre Haare im Drogeriemarkt.
sentence_example_translation_en: She bought a tint for her hair at the drugstore.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она купила тонировку для волос в аптеке.
sentence_synonym: Sie kaufte eine Färbung für ihre Haare im Drogeriemarkt.
typical_collocations: eine leichte Tönung; Tönung auswaschen; feine Tönung
usage_comments_en: Refers to light coloration. In cosmetics, it is a semi-permanent hair dye. In arts and optics, it refers to a subtle shade or nuance of color.

word_translation_en: to tone down; to shade; to nuance
sentence_example: Der Maler wollte das helle Blau mit etwas Grau abtönen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The painter wanted to tone down the bright blue with some gray.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Художник хотел приглушить ярко-синий цвет серым.
sentence_synonym: Der Maler wollte das helle Blau mit etwas Grau abschwächen.
typical_collocations: Farben abtönen; eine Aussage abtönen; eine Wand abtönen
usage_comments_en: Often used in painting for mixing colors to make them less intense. Figuratively, it means to modify or nuance a spoken statement to make it less harsh.

word_translation_en: to hint at; to touch upon; to mention briefly
sentence_example: Wir haben das Thema beim Abendessen kurz angetönt.
sentence_example_translation_en: We briefly touched upon the topic during dinner.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы вскользь затронули эту тему за ужином.
sentence_synonym: Wir haben das Thema beim Abendessen kurz angedeutet.
typical_collocations: ein Problem antönen; kurz antönen; ein Thema antönen
usage_comments_en: Mainly used in Swiss Standard German (Helvetism). It corresponds to 'andeuten' or 'ansprechen' in standard High German in Germany.

word_translation_en: to fade out; to die away (of sound)
sentence_example: Der Pianist ließ den letzten Ton langsam austönen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The pianist let the last note slowly fade out.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Пианист позволил последней ноте медленно затихнуть.
sentence_synonym: Der Pianist ließ den letzten Ton langsam ausklingen.
usage_comments_en: A specialized or poetic verb meaning to allow a musical note or sound to fully fade into silence. Mostly used transitively with 'lassen' or intransitively.

word_translation_en: to sound; to ring out; to resound
sentence_example: Das Signal zum Aufbruch ertönte pünktlich.
sentence_example_translation_en: The signal to depart rang out on time.
sentence_synonym: Das Signal zum Aufbruch erschallte pünktlich.
typical_collocations: eine Sirene ertönt; die Glocken ertönen; Beifall ertönt
usage_comments_en: An intransitive verb conjugated with 'sein'. It describes the sudden starting or sounding of a signal, bell, voice, or instrument. Highly common in literary style.

word_translation_en: to continue sounding; to echo on
sentence_example: Die Melodie schien noch lange in den Gängen fortzutönen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The melody seemed to continue sounding in the hallways for a long time.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мелодия, казалось, еще долго продолжала звучать в коридорах.
sentence_synonym: Die Melodie schien noch lange in den Gängen nachzuhallen.
usage_comments_en: A rare, elevated, and poetic verb describing a sound that continues to play or resonate in space or in memory.

word_translation_en: to drown out; to muffle; to shout down
sentence_example: Er musste schreien, um den Lärm des Verkehrs zu übertönen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He had to shout to drown out the noise of the traffic.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему пришлось кричать, чтобы заглушить шум транспорта.
sentence_synonym: Er musste schreien, um den Lärm des Verkehrs zu überdecken.
typical_collocations: ein Geräusch übertönen; den Lärm übertönen; jemandes Stimme übertönen
usage_comments_en: Transitive verb. It means to make a sound that is louder than another sound, making the first one inaudible. Often used metaphorically (e.g., to suppress feelings/doubts).

word_translation_en: to die away; to fade away (of sound)
sentence_example: Die Schritte vertönten allmählich in der Ferne.
sentence_example_translation_en: The footsteps gradually died away in the distance.
sentence_synonym: Die Schritte verklangen allmählich in der Ferne.
typical_collocations: leise vertönen; in der Ferne vertönen
usage_comments_en: An intransitive verb conjugated with 'sein'. It means a sound gradually gets quieter and fades out. It is rare and poetic. Do not confuse with 'vertonen' (to set to music).
